    Every oven & carpet job, priced

    Pick the job that matches yours — each one loads the estimator with the right settings.

    Single oven clean

    The most-booked job in the country: one standard built-in or freestanding oven, deep-cleaned inside and out. Burnt-on carbon, greasy racks and cloudy door glass all come off — most pros soak racks and trays in a dip tank in their van, so there's no chemical mess in your kitchen.

    £50 – £70 · average ~£66 Estimate a single oven clean →

    Double oven clean

    Two cavities, twice the racks, trays and glass — priced as one job, not two. The main oven and top oven/grill both get the full treatment in a single visit.

    ~£105 Estimate a double oven clean →

    AGA & range cooker cleaning

    Big cookers need a specialist: multiple ovens, hotplates, lids and enamel that punishes the wrong products. It's the longest, priciest oven job — and the one where a proper pro earns their money.

    up to £160 Estimate an AGA / range clean →

    Carpet cleaning per room

    One room at a time: a hallway flattened by foot traffic, a bedroom, or the living room before guests arrive. Hot-water extraction lifts ground-in dirt a hire machine leaves behind. Note the ~£85 minimum call-out on small jobs.

    £30 – £70 per room · average ~£49 Estimate one room →

    Whole-house carpet clean

    Every carpeted room in one visit — living room, bedrooms, hall and stairs. Per-room pricing means the more rooms in a single booking, the better the value per room, and the house is done in a few hours.

    ~£49 per room on average Estimate a whole house →

    Oven + carpet bundle

    The smart booking: one visit, one set-up, the two dirtiest jobs in the house sorted together. A single or double oven plus two to three carpeted rooms is the classic combined ticket across the Midlands and North.

    £210 – £310 typical total Estimate the bundle →

    End-of-tenancy oven & carpet

    Moving out? The oven and the carpets are the two things letting agents inspect hardest — and the two most common deposit deductions. A professional clean with an invoice gives you evidence the job was done properly.

    Carpets ~£40/room in tenancy guides Estimate an end-of-tenancy clean →

    Pre-Christmas deep clean

    November–December is peak season: the oven works hardest at Christmas, and so does the living-room carpet. Book one to two weeks ahead — the best local firms in the big cities fill their diaries fast.

    Bundle £210 – £310 typical Estimate a pre-Christmas clean →

    Pet-stain carpet cleaning

    Muddy paws, accidents and that lingering dog smell: enzyme pre-treatment plus hot-water extraction tackles stains and odours together. Mention your pets in the request pack so the cleaner brings the right products first time.

    £30 – £70 per room + treatment quoted on inspection Estimate a pet-stain clean →

    Upholstery add-on

    While the extraction machine is in the house, adding the sofa and armchairs is the cheapest time to do it. Fabric upholstery is cleaned with the same hot-water extraction method as carpets, at a gentler setting. Add it in the estimator and the cleaner will quote it alongside your main job — no second call-out, no second day of waiting in.

    Oven & carpet cleaning — your questions answered

    How much does professional oven cleaning cost in the UK in 2026?

    A single oven clean typically costs £50–£70, with an average of around £66 in Bark's 2026 price guides. A double oven averages around £105, and a large AGA or range cooker can cost up to £160 because of its size and extra compartments.

    How much does carpet cleaning cost per room?

    Typically £30–£70 per room, averaging around £49 per room (about £40 per room in end-of-tenancy guides). Most firms apply a minimum call-out of around £85, so one small room on its own can cost more than the per-room rate.

    How much does an oven and carpet clean cost together?

    A combined job — typically a single or double oven plus two to three carpeted rooms — usually totals around £210–£310 in 2026. One visit for both jobs is often better value than two separate call-outs.

    Does this website send my details to cleaning companies?

    No. This page sends nothing to any cleaner by itself. The estimator builds a request pack on your own device; you download, copy or email it to cleaners you choose. Direct matching with firms is a possible future launch model only — it is not active here.

    What is included in a professional oven clean?

    Usually the oven cavity, racks and trays (often dip-tank soaked), door glass inside and out, and knobs. AGA and range cleans also cover hotplates, lids and every separate oven. Extractors and separate hobs are normally quoted as extras.

    When is the busiest time to book?

    November and December — pre-Christmas deep cleans plus end-of-tenancy moves. In Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds and the other big cities, book one to two weeks ahead at peak time.

    Can pet stains and odours be removed from carpets?

    Usually, yes: hot-water extraction with an enzyme pre-treatment lifts most pet stains and neutralises odours. Stains that have soaked through to the underlay may not come out fully, so cleaners normally quote pet-stain work after photos or inspection. Mention pets in your pack so the right products arrive with the cleaner.

    Which areas does this site cover?

    The focus is the Midlands and the North: Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds, Sheffield, Liverpool, Nottingham, Leicester and Newcastle. The prices are UK-wide 2026 guide prices, so the estimate is still a sound starting point anywhere in the UK.
